getting-started-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
getting-started-talking-to-elena.text: You too, thanks for freeing me.

getting-started-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
getting-started-talking-to-elena.text: It's just a shame the mourners confiscated my equipment.

getting-started-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
getting-started-talking-to-elena.text: My distillator. I can't test any plague samples without it. They're holding it in the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne.

getting-started-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
getting-started-talking-to-elena.text: I must somehow retrieve that distillator if I am to find a cure for this awful affliction. Do you think you could help me?

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Of course I can help. Where do we start?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I was hoping you would say that. Unfortunately they discovered the tunnel and filled it in. We need another way over the wall.

steps.player: Any ideas?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: My father's friend Jerico is in communication with West Ardougne. He might be able to help us. He lives in a house south east of here, north of the chapel.

options.text: No.

steps.player: I'm busy at the moment, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Fair enough.

getting-started-talking-to-elena-trying-.text: The ground's been filled in and packed hard.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico.text: Hello, I've been expecting you. Elena tells me you need to cross the wall.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico.text: My messenger pigeons help me communicate with friends over the wall.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico.text: I have arranged for two of them to aid you with a rope ladder. Omart is waiting for you at the southern end of the wall.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico.text: But be careful, if the mourners catch you, the punishment will be severe.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-again.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico-again.text: Hello again. Have you spoken to Omart yet?

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-again.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico-again.text: You'll find him at the southern end of the wall. Keep an eye out for them mourners.

getting-started-searching-the-cupboard.text: The cupboard is full of bird feed.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You find some bird feed in the cupboard but you don't have enough room to take it.

getting-started-searching-the-cupboard.text: If the player already has bird feed:

steps.player: I don't need any more bird feed.

getting-started-searching-the-cupboard.player: Mmm, bird feed! Now what could I do with that?

getting-started-talking-to-omart.player: Omart, Jerico said you might be able to help me.

getting-started-talking-to-omart.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart.text: He informed me of your problem traveller. I would be glad to help, I have a rope ladder and my associate, Kilron, is waiting on the other side.

getting-started-talking-to-omart.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart.text: Unfortunately we can't risk it with the watchtower so close. So first we need to distract the guards in the tower.

getting-started-talking-to-omart.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart.text: I reckon some of Jerico's pigeons might help us out here. Chuck some bird feed at the tower and then release some pigeons nearby. They should provide a nice distraction.

getting-started-talking-to-omart.player: Where do I get the bird feed and the pigeons?

getting-started-talking-to-omart.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart.text: I'm sure Jerico can help you out with that if you ask him nicely.

getting-started-talking-to-omart-talking.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart-talking.text: Hello. Have you sorted that distraction yet?

getting-started-talking-to-omart-talking.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart-talking.text: Try using some of Jerico's pigeons. Chuck some bird feed at the tower and then release some pigeons nearby. Jerico should be able to help you out.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.text: Hello again. Have you spoken to Omart yet?

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.player: I have. He told me to ask you about some pigeons.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.text: Pigeons? What do you need my pigeons for?

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.player: Omart thought they'd make a good distraction for the guards.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.text: Ahh, very clever. Well I'm sure I can let you borrow some, as long as you look after them. Just grab one of the cages from behind my house. You'll want some bird feed as well. I should have some in my cupboard.

getting-started-throwing-bird-feed.text: If the player is not near the watchtower fence:

steps.player: I probably shouldn't waste it by throwing it here.

getting-started-throwing-bird-feed.text: If the player is near the fence:

steps.text: You throw a handful of seeds onto the watchtower. The mourners do not seem to notice.

getting-started-opening-pigeon-cage.text: If the player is in the wrong place or has not thrown the bird feed:

steps.text: The pigeons don't want to leave.

getting-started-opening-pigeon-cage.text: If the player has thrown the bird feed and is near the watchtower fence:

steps.text: The pigeons fly towards the watchtower. The mourners frantically try to scare them away.

getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.speaker: Jerico
getting-started-talking-to-jerico-after-.text: The guards are distracted by the birds, you must go now, quickly traveller.

getting-started-talking-to-omart-after-f.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart-after-f.text: Well done, the guards are having real trouble with those birds. You must go now traveller, it's your only chance.

options.text: Okay, lets do it.

steps.player: Okay, lets do it.

steps.text: If the player is not wearing a gas mask:

steps.speaker: Omart
steps.text: I'd recommend you wear a gas mask before entering West Ardougne. You don't want to risk catching the plague.

steps.player: That would be wise. Thanks Omart.

steps.text: Omart throws a rope ladder over the wall.
You climb up the rope ladder...
...and drop down on the other side.

steps.speaker: Kilron
steps.text: Welcome to West Ardougne friend. I'm Kilron. Let me know if you want to go back over the wall.

steps.player: Thanks Kilron. Do you know where to find the Mourner Headquarters?

steps.speaker: Kilron
steps.text: It's the most north eastern building in the city. Be careful around there.

options.text: I'll be back soon.

steps.player: I'll be back soon.

steps.speaker: Omart
steps.text: Don't take too long, those mourners will soon be rid of those birds.

getting-started-talking-to-omart-after-e.speaker: Omart
getting-started-talking-to-omart-after-e.text: Hello traveller. Do you wish to cross the wall?

options.text: Okay, let's do it.

steps.player: Okay, lets do it.

steps.text: Omart throws a rope ladder over the wall.
You climb up the rope ladder...
...and drop down on the other side.

options.text: I'll be back soon.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-attempting-t.text: You should leave your gas mask on while you're in West Ardougne

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-k.speaker: Kilron
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-k.text: Hello traveller. Do you need to go back over?

options.text: Yes I do.

steps.player: Yes I do.

steps.speaker: Kilron
steps.text: Okay, quickly now!
Kilron throws a rope ladder over the wall.
You climb up the rope ladder...
...and drop down on the other side.

options.text: Do you know where to find the Mourner Headquarters?

steps.player: Do you know where to find the Mourner Headquarters?

steps.speaker: Kilron
steps.text: It's the most north eastern building in the city. Be careful around there.

options.text: Not yet Kilron.

steps.player: Not yet Kilron.

steps.speaker: Kilron
steps.text: Okay, just give me the word.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-j.speaker: Jerico
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-j.text: So you've returned traveller. Did you get what you wanted?

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-j.speaker: Jerico
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-j.text: Omart will be waiting by the wall, in case you need to cross again.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: Back away citizen. Only mourners are allowed inside the headquarters.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.player: Hmm. I wonder if there's another way in.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-inspecting-c.player: Looks like a nice stew is being prepared. This must be to feed all of the mourners.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.speaker: Nurse Sarah
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.text: I don't know how much longer I can cope here.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.player: What? Is the plague getting to you?

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.speaker: Nurse Sarah
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.text: No, strangely enough the people here don't seem to be affected. It's just the awful living conditions that is making people ill.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.player: I was under the impression that everyone here was affected.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.speaker: Nurse Sarah
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-n.text: Me too, but that doesn't seem to be the case.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-using-rotten.text: You place the rotten apple in the pot. It quickly dissolves into the stew.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-using-rotten.player: Anyone who eats this stew is going to have a bad time now.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-opening-back.player: Eugh, locked. There must be a way for me to get in. Maybe there's something around here that will help me.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: Back away citizen. Several mourners are ill with food poisoning.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.player: Is there a doctor nearby? Maybe I can go fetch them.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: There are no doctors in West Ardougne, just that nurse south west of the chapel. You don't need to worry though, we'll soon have it sorted.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-searching-cu.text: If the player has not yet poisoned the stew or already has a medical gown:

steps.text: You search the cupboard but you find nothing of interest.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-searching-cu.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You find a medical gown in the cupboard but you don't have enough room to take it.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-searching-cu.text: You find a medical gown in the cupboard.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: A doctor? I didn't think there were any left around here.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.player: I heard there was some trouble with food poisoning here.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: You heard right. Head on in and see what you can do.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-attempting-t.text: You should leave your medical gown on while you're in the Mourner Headquarters.
The trapdoor is bolted on the other side.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: Oh dear oh dear. I feel terrible, I think it was the stew.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.player: You should be more careful with your ingredients.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: There is one mourner who's really sick. They're resting upstairs. You should see to them first.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.text: A doctor? At last! I don't know what I've eaten but I feel like I'm on death's door.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.player: Hmm... interesting, sounds like food poisoning.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.text: Yes, I'd figured that out already. What can you give me to help.

options.text: Just hold your breath and count to ten.

steps.player: Just hold your breath and count to ten.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: What? How will that help? What kind of doctor are you?

steps.player: Erm... I'm new, I just started.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: You're no doctor!
(Mourner attacks the player.)

options.text: The best I can do is pray for you.

steps.player: The best I can do is pray for you.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Pray for me? You're no doctor... You're an imposter!
(Mourner attacks the player.)

options.text: There's nothing I can do, it's fatal.

steps.player: There's nothing I can do, it's fatal.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: No, I'm too young to die! I've never even had a girlfriend.

steps.player: That's life for you.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: Wait a minute, where's your equipment?

steps.player: It's erm... at home.

steps.speaker: Mourner
steps.text: You're no doctor!
(Mourner attacks the player.)

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-s.text: Sorry, I'd like to be left in peace.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-opening-the-.text: If the player has the key:

steps.text: You use the key to open the gate.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-opening-the-.text: If the player does not have the key:

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-searching-th.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You search the crate and find Elena's distillator but you don't have enough room to take it.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-searching-th.text: If the player already has the distillator:

steps.text: You search the crate but find nothing of interest.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-searching-th.text: You search the crate and find Elena's distillator.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.speaker: Mourner
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.text: Oh dear oh dear. I feel terrible, I think it was the stew.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-m.player: You should be more careful with your ingredients.

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-e.speaker: Elena
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-e.text: You're back, did you find the distillator?

infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-e.speaker: Elena
infiltrating-the-mourner-hq-talking-to-e.text: I can't test the samples without the distillator. Please don't give up until you find it.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: You're back, did you find the distillator?

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: Great! Now I can finally run these tests.
Elena uses the distillator to test some samples.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: I don't understand... the touch paper hasn't changed colour at all...

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: I'm not sure. My old mentor in Varrock, Guidor, might know though. Could you take these to him and see what he thinks? You'll need to drop by the chemist in Rimmington first to pick up some more touch paper.
Elena gives you a plague sample along with three vials.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: Now, last time I went to see Guidor, some one told the guards I was carrying some plague samples. Annoyingly, that means they've started searching everyone going to that part of the city.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: Ironically, the guards won't be smart enough to recognise the sample itself, so you should be able to get that in just fine. They'll probably confiscate the rest though.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: Well I know the chemist has still been managing to get chemicals to Guidor. Maybe he can help you smuggle the things in.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.player: Great, I'll see if he can help. See you soon.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.speaker: Elena
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-elena-.text: What are you doing back here?

options.text: I just find it hard to say goodbye sometimes.

steps.player: I just find it hard to say goodbye sometimes.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I see... I understand what you mean... But let's discuss that later.

options.text: I'm afraid I've lost some of the stuff that you gave me...

steps.player: I'm afraid I've lost some of the stuff that you gave me...

steps.text: If the player has all the items:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Are you sure? Looks like you have everything to me.
If the player is missing items:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: That's alright, I've got plenty.
If the player has no inventory space:
Elena tries to give you some items but you don't have enough room for them.
Elena replaces your lost items.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: There you go. That should be everything.

steps.player: Great, I'll be on my way.

options.text: I've forgotten what I need to do.

steps.player: I've forgotten what I need to do.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Go to Rimmington and get some touch paper from the chemist. Once you've done that, you'll need to take those things to Guidor in Varrock.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: You'll probably need to smuggle some of the items in to stop them getting confiscated. If you need help moving them discreetly, the chemist might be able to assist you.

steps.player: Okay, I'll get to it.

options.text: Nothing.

steps.player: Nothing.

delivering-the-samples-talking-to-omart-.speaker: Omart
delivering-the-samples-talking-to-omart-.text: Hello adventurer. I'm afraid it's too risky to use the ladder again. You'll have to find another way into the city.

visiting-the-chemist-house-in-rimmington.speaker: Chancy
visiting-the-chemist-house-in-rimmington.text: Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck.

visiting-the-chemist-house-in-rimmington.prompt: What do you want to talk about?

options.text: Lamps.
Your quest.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: Sorry, I'm afraid we're just closing now. You'll have to come back another time.

steps.player: But I was sent by Elena from Ardougne.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: Oh, well that's different then. Must be pretty important for her to send you all this way.

steps.player: She asked me to pick up some touch paper for a guy called Guidor.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: Guidor? This one's on me then, I owe him more than a few favours.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: I should warn you though, getting to him might not be easy if you're carrying any chemicals. The guards are searching anyone heading to that part of Varrock.

steps.player: Oh right... so am I going to be okay carrying these three vials with me?

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: With touch paper as well? You're asking for trouble. You'd better use my errand boys outside. Give them a vial each. I must warn you though, they do have a habit of stealing things.

steps.player: Well that's no good. How do I stop them stealing my vials?

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: Just make sure you give them something they have no reason to steal. One's a painter, one's a gambler, and one's a drunk. Not ideal I know, but if you pay peanuts you'll get monkeys, right?
The chemist gives you some touch paper.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: Now don't stand around here gassing. This is clearly important to Elena. You'll find Guidor's home in the south east corner of Varrock.

steps.player: Okay, thanks for your help. I know Elena appreciates it.

options.text: Impling jars.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-c.speaker: Chancy

options.text: I'm getting a bad feeling about this.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.speaker: Da Vinci
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.text: Absolutely. It's just not stored in a vial anymore.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.speaker: Da Vinci
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.text: Instead it has been liberated. It now gleams from the canvas of my latest epic: The Majesty of Varrock!

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.player: That's great. Thanks to you I'll have to walk back to East Ardougne to get another vial.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.speaker: Da Vinci
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.text: Well you can't put a price on art.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.speaker: Da Vinci

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-d.player: Well, as they say, it's always sunny in Gielinor.

visiting-south-east-varrock-entering-gui.speaker: Julie
visiting-south-east-varrock-entering-gui.text: Please leave my husband alone. He's very sick, and I don't want anyone bothering him.

visiting-south-east-varrock-entering-gui.player: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?

visiting-south-east-varrock-entering-gui.speaker: Julie
visiting-south-east-varrock-entering-gui.text: Thank you, but I just want him to see a priest.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.speaker: Julie
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.text: Oh dear! Oh dear! I don't have time to chat!

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.player: Hello. I'm a friend of Elena, here to see Guidor.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.speaker: Julie
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.text: I'm afraid that Guidor is not long for this world! So I'm not letting people see him now.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.player: I'm really sorry to hear about Guidor.
But I do have some very important business to attend to!

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.speaker: Julie
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.text: You heartless rogue! What could be more important than Guidor's life? A life spent well, if not always wisely... I just hope that Saradomin shows mercy on his soul!

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.speaker: Julie

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-a.speaker: Asyff

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-a.speaker: Asyff

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.player: Hello, you must be Guidor. I understand that you are unwell.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.speaker: Guidor
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.text: Is my wife asking priests to visit me now? I'm a man of science for god's sake. I know she means well but it's only a little cough!

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.player: She made out it was something more serious.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.speaker: Guidor
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.text: Well it's not killed me yet. So what do you want?

options.text: I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague.

steps.player: I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: You mean the plague of West Ardougne?

steps.player: That's the one. I have a sample here from your former student, Elena.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Elena eh?

steps.player: Yes, she wants you to analyse it. You might be the only one who can help.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Right then, sounds like we'd better get to work!

steps.player: I have the plague sample.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Now I'll be needing some liquid honey, some sulphuric broline, and then...

steps.player: ... some ethenea?

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Indeed!
If the player does not have all three vials:

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Look, I need all three reagents to test the plague sample. Come back when you've got them.
If the player does not have touch paper:

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Oh. You don't have any touch paper. I won't be able to help after all.
If the player does not have the plague sample:

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Seems like you don't actually have the plague sample. It's a long way to come empty handed... and quite a long way back too.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Now I'll just apply these to the sample and... I don't get it... the touch paper has remained the same.

steps.player: That's why Elena wanted you to do it, because she wasn't sure what was happening.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Well that's just it, nothing has happened. I don't know what this sample is, but it certainly isn't toxic.

steps.player: So what about the plague?

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: This result can only mean one thing... there is no plague. It seems that someone has been lying about all of it. The only question is... why?

steps.player: Well this is worrying. I'd better go and tell Elena right away.

options.text: I was just going to bless your room and I've done that now.

steps.player: I was just going to bless your room and I've done that now.

steps.speaker: Guidor
steps.text: Oh. Goodbye then.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.speaker: Guidor
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.text: Well, hello traveller. I still can't understand why they would lie about the plague.

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-g.player: It's strange, anyway how are you doing?

visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.speaker: Julie
visiting-south-east-varrock-talking-to-j.text: Hello there. I fear Guidor may not be long for this world!

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: You're back! So what did Guidor say?

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.player: He ran his tests and discovered nothing. The plague... it doesn't exist.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: Doesn't exist? But I don't understand... why?

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.player: I don't know, but I think we're about to uncover something huge.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: Well I think there's only one thing for it. The king must be confronted!

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: Yes. King Lathas of East Ardougne. He was the one that had the wall built. He was the one who called the mourners in. He must know what's really going on here.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.player: Well I'd better go and speak to the king then.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: Be quick. You should find him in the castle.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: You must go and see King Lathas immediately!

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.player: I assume that you are King Lathas of East Ardougne?

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: You assume correctly, but where do you get such impertinence.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.player: I get it from finding out that the plague is a hoax.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: A hoax? I've never heard such a ridiculous thing...

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.player: I have evidence, from Guidor of Varrock.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: Ah... I see. Well then you are right about the plague. But I did it for the good of my people.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.player: When is it ever good to lie to people like that?

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: When it protects them from a far greater danger, a fear too big to fathom.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: When my father was king, he ruled over a united Ardougne. But on his deathbed, he could not decide which of his sons should succeed him, so he had the city split into two.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: I became king of East Ardougne while my brother, Tyras, ruled over West Ardougne. My brother was a good man and was great at many things. Being a king was not one of them.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: Rather than looking after his people, he went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: And so I erected the wall, not just to protect my people, but to protect all the people of Gielinor. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: I knew people would never believe the truth, so I had the plague made up as an excuse for the cordon. I'm not proud of it, but it was the only way to keep people safe.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.player: I see. Well at least I know now.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: While my brother is still at large, I must ask that you keep this secret. We can't bring the wall down until we know he is no longer a danger.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.player: But how do we stop him?

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: You're willing to help? Gods be praised!

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: My brother is currently gathering strength in the lands to the west. If we are to stop him, we must find a way through the mountains. There is an underground pass that should lead through but it is full of danger.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: Return to me when you are ready to face this peril. Until then, I give you permission to use my training area. It's located just to the north west of the city.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: I'll also let the mourners know that you are a friend to Ardougne. You will be allowed to pass through the gates to West Ardougne whenever you please. Now, you'd better be off. You have much to prepare for.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: Do you need anything else adventurer?

options.text: Why don't I get started right away?

steps.player: Why don't I get started right away?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Your enthusiasm is to be commended. Very well, if you feel you are already prepared then who am I to stop you.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: As we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.
(Continues with Underground Pass dialogue.)

options.text: I don't think so.

steps.player: I don't think so.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Very well. Return to me once you are ready and we will discuss our next steps.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.speaker: King Lathas
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-king-latha.text: And to you adventurer. I assume you're here about King Tyras?

options.text: I am. What's our plan?

steps.player: I am. What's our plan?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Well, as we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.
(Continues with Underground Pass dialogue.)

options.text: I'm just passing through.

steps.player: I'm just passing through.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Fair enough. Return to me when you are ready and we will discuss our next steps.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: Not bad, did you speak to the king?

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.player: I did, he admitted the plague is a hoax.
He did. He asked me to keep it a secret though.
I'm afraid so. Don't worry though, I'm working with the king to resolve all of this.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: I hope so. Even without the plague, I still worry about the people of West Ardougne.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: Not bad, I do wish you could tell me what's going on with the plague though.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.player: So do I Elena. I promise I'll tell you everything once this is all over.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.speaker: Elena
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-elena-afte.text: I hope that's not too far off.

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-julie-afte.speaker: Julie
return-to-ardougne-talking-to-julie-afte.text: Oh hello, I can't chat now. I have to keep an eye on my husband. He's very ill!

return-to-ardougne-talking-to-guidor-aft.player: Hello again Guidor. How are you doing?

dW9Dl-.speaker: Da Vinci
dW9Dl-.text: Bah! A great artist such as myself should not have to suffer the HUMILIATION of spending time where the likes of you wander everywhere!
